Malay Text
Sekawan merpati ternampak dedak bertaburan di bawah pokok. Mereka pun hinggap di bawah pokok. Ketika mula makan dedak itu, baru mereka sedar diri mereka terperangkap dalam serawan jala yang dipasang oleh pemburu.
"Kita tidak boleh patah semangat. Mari kita terbang bersama-sama dengan membawa jala ini sekali," kata ketua merpati.
Translation
A flock of pigeons saw seeds scattered under a tree. They landed under the tree. As they began eating the seeds, they suddenly realized they were trapped in a net set up by a hunter.
"We must not lose our spirit. Let's fly together, carrying this net with us," said the leader pigeon.

Malay Text
Tidak lama kemudian, pemburu terkejut apabila nampak merpati-merpati itu terbang tinggi dengan mengangkut jala itu.
"Jangan bimbang. Rakan saya, Raja Tikus pasti akan menolong kita. Mari kita terbang ke rumahnya," kata ketua merpati itu lagi.
Tidak lama kemudian, mereka sampai di rumah Raja Tikus.
Translation
Not long after, the hunter was shocked to see the pigeons flying high while carrying the net.
"Don't worry. My friend, the Rat King, will surely help us. Let's fly to his home," said the leader pigeon again.
Not long after, they arrived at the Rat King's home.

Malay Text
Ketua merpati pun menceritakan perkara sebenar kepada Raja Tikus. Tanpa membuang masa, Raja Tikus pun menggigit jala itu. Akhirnya, kesemua merpati bebas.
Ketua merpati dan semua burung lain mengucapkan jutaan terima kasih kepada Raja Tikus.
Apabila bertindak secara bersatu akan bertambah teguh.
Translation
The leader pigeon told the Rat King the real situation. Without wasting time, the Rat King bit through the net. Finally, all the pigeons were free.
The leader pigeon and all the other birds thanked the Rat King a million times.
When we act together, we become stronger.
